regime.headline: Long and real yields have moved higher while credit stays calm and AI/semiconductor breadth is strong — transmission to broader market stress is incomplete and NVDA at/near ATH raises conditional fragility.
regime.answer: Nominal and real long yields have risen alongside an ACM-term‑premium uptick, but HY/IG spreads remain muted and AI-basket breadth is robust; the regime is a rates-led tightening that has not yet transmitted broadly, leaving concentrated names (NVDA/semis) to prop headline indices and create conditional fragility.
regime.implication: Higher real and nominal yields are tightening financial conditions, yet credit spreads and volatility have not confirmed systemic stress; concentrated AI/semiconductor leadership is insulating headline indices and raising fragility if yields or credit widen.
regime.whatWouldChangeMind: Sustained HY/IG widening, a clear MOVE/VIX pickup, or breadth deterioration outside AI/semis (breadth ex‑AI collapsing) would indicate transmission and invalidate the incomplete‑transmission reading.

stories.title: Rates pressure is real‑yield led with a recent term‑premium uptick
stories.whatChanged: 10Y real yields rose materially and the NY Fed ACM model shows a ~0.96% 10Y term premium with a five‑session rise, while nominal long yields also moved higher.
stories.whyItMatters: Real‑yield and term‑premium strength tighten financing conditions even if credit spreads and volatility remain subdued, raising the bar for growth‑sensitive assets.
stories.mechanism: A rise in real yields (and a governed term‑premium increase) is raising nominal long yields; absent simultaneous credit widening or volatility spikes, the tightening is concentrated in duration/real‑yield channels rather than a full market risk‑off.
stories.conclusion: Evidence supports a real‑yield‑led rise in long yields with a concurrent governed term‑premium uptick; this tightens conditions but has not yet transmitted into credit or volatility.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Evidence of sustained HY/IG widening, a clear MOVE increase, or auction/ dealer‑absorption failures would overturn the 'incomplete transmission' conclusion.

stories.title: Concentrated AI/semiconductor leadership is propping headline indices and creating conditional fragility
stories.whatChanged: AI infrastructure/semiconductor breadth is markedly stronger than broad large‑cap breadth while NVDA is at or near all‑time highs.
stories.whyItMatters: Index gains are concentrated; if rates or credit widen further, the narrow leadership could unwind and drive broader weakness.
stories.mechanism: Concentrated gains (NVDA and semis) mask underlying breadth weakness; this concentration means equity indices can remain elevated even as tighter rates increase downside risk should flows reverse or credit deteriorate.
stories.conclusion: AI/semiconductor leadership is materially supporting headline performance and creates conditional fragility given rising yields and calm credit.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Broadening participation (breadth ex‑AI improvement) or evidence that NVDA moves are isolated short‑covering rather than fresh buying would weaken this story.

stories.title: Refined‑product cracks are elevated and may be supporting breakevens despite softer crude
stories.whatChanged: Distillate/heating‑oil proxies remain elevated while WTI has softened, and 10Y breakevens are steady.
stories.whyItMatters: Product‑led inflation support can sustain breakevens and long yields even if crude weakens, keeping upward pressure on rates.
stories.mechanism: Regional or product‑specific tightness (distillates/heating oil) can raise breakevens and long yields independently from WTI spot direction if physical availability or distribution constrains persist.
stories.conclusion: Product cracks are consistent with product‑led support for breakevens, but regional inventory and refinery utilisation confirmation is still required.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Regional inventory builds, normalising refinery utilisation, or falling prompt cracks would weaken the product‑support thesis.

investigations.question: Is repricing in long/real yields and term premium transmitting into credit spreads, breadth deterioration and volatility?
investigations.whyItMatters: If higher real yields and term premium broaden into credit and volatility, the regime moves from concentrated rates pressure to broader market stress.
investigations.currentExplanation: Nominal and real long yields plus a NY Fed ACM term‑premium uptick are present while HY/IG spreads remain muted and AI/semis breadth is strong, consistent with incomplete transmission thus far.
investigations.expectedReaction: Conventional: rising real yields/front end should widen credit spreads, lift VIX and weaken broad breadth/small caps.
investigations.observedReaction: 10Y nominal and real yields rose and ACM term premium increased, while HY/IG spreads are still modest and AI-basket breadth is strong.
competingExplanations: Concentrated AI/semis leadership is insulating headline indices.
Dealer/market‑structure absorption is delaying transmission to credit and breadth.
Credit widening is lagged and will follow if yields persist.

candidateExplanations.explanation: AI/semis concentration is propping indices and masking breadth weakness.
candidateExplanations.discriminatingTest: Breadth ex‑AI deteriorates materially while AI breadth stays elevated over the next 3–7 sessions.
